QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_19

question.text: Which of the following is a SEBI-listed permitted procedure for addressing conflict of interest in an AIF (as per the Stewardship Circular reference)?

answer.text: Blanket bans on investments in certain cases; a 'Conflict of Interest' Committee; clear segregation of voting and client-relations/sales functions; recusal policy; minute-keeping and periodic review/update.
Delegating all conflict decisions to the investee company.

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI's listed procedures for addressing conflict of interest include: (i) blanket bans on investments in certain cases; (ii) a Conflict of Interest Committee; (iii) segregation of voting function from client relations/sales; (iv) recusal policy for persons with actual/potential conflict; (v) maintenance of minutes; and (vi) periodic review/update with disclosure. The Trap: The other three options are all antithetical to SEBI governance principles. Note: Pages 281-282 of the workbook enumerate these SEBI-listed conflict-of-interest procedures.
